messages:
leo_sales: Heads-up: Aurora Labs reported a sudden p95 jump on their dedicated pool after last night's model rollout — from ~200ms to ~900ms. They opened a support ticket and want a mitigation within 24h.

maya_pm: thanks Leo. Do we have sample trace ids & whether they're using autoscale or fixed nodes?

leo_sales: sample ids shared in DM. They're on reserved capacity (no autoscale). No changes on their side.

femi_eng: quick check: there was a change to routing fallback rules in catalog_push at 23:40 UTC that introduced a new 4-bit quantized variant. Pulling metrics for Aurora's pool now.

tess_oncall: I see enqueueing on their worker pool starting 23:45-00:30 UTC with increased batch sizes and GPU stalls. CPU side shows jitter in the serving agent. Trace ids added.

raj_support: Customer saw a few 429s before the tail spike. I drafted an interim customer message: offer to pin them to previous model variant + short window of extra capacity. PM ok?

maya_pm: agree to both mitigations. Short-term: apply a per-customer routing pin to previous variant and spin +1 node for 2 hours. Medium-term: rollback the fallback, add rollout gating that flags per-variant cold-start regressions, and create a perf test for quantized binaries.

femi_eng: I can do route-pin now and open a hotfix PR to add a per-customer override flag. Estimate 2 dev-hours for patch + canary.

tess_oncall: route-pin applied at 00:05 UTC for Aurora. Spun an extra node. Monitoring.

metrics_bot: alert: Aurora p95 normalized at 00:12 UTC. Dashboards show p95 back to ~220ms.

raj_support: Customer confirmed: "latency back to normal, thanks". I'll keep them updated and schedule a 24h check-in.

maya_pm: creating backlog item PROD-4927: "quantized-fallback cold-start regression affecting dedicated pools" severity=P2, owner=femi_eng, milestone=hotfix. Acceptance: canary shows normalized p95 and variant-level telemetry added.

femi_eng: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/routing/pull/358 (hotfix: per-customer route override). Starting canary across 5% of dedicated pools.

tess_oncall: canary looks good for Aurora; no new errors. I'll update autoscale runbook with steps for manual headroom and route-pins.

maya_pm: action items:
- femi_eng: merge hotfix and roll to all dedicated pools after validation (ETA EOD).
- platform + infra: add rollout gating checks for quantized variants (perf threshold + telemetry) (ETA 2 sprints).
- raj_support: close customer incident when follow-up confirmed.

maya_pm: thanks team 44d if anyone wants to argue severity or timeline speak now. Otherwise we'll treat this as a P2 customer-facing regression and prioritize the hotfix.
